complete_video_analysis.limitations: Automatic scene boundaries and wording may be approximate; source code and visual tests are separate.

scenes.audio: Let's look at two more things that are closest to our lives.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A clean white background. Large purple and black graphics occupy the center of the frame. The camera is static with no movement. The lighting is perfectly flat and artificial, creating a studio-graphic feel with high saturation and contrast between the white void and the bold colors.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A square smart home display device is centered against a pure white background. The device has a thick black bezel and a stand. The screen displays a blue artistic image with a white text box overlay. The camera remains static. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the sleek industrial design of the hardware.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The same square smart home display is shown, slightly closer. The focus is on the screen's dimensions. The background remains white. A thin blue line appears on the screen momentarily to highlight the display area. The lighting remains consistent and bright.

scenes.audio: It can recognize different people in the family.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: A tight zoom on the upper corner of the interface. Small circular profile icons representing different users appear at the top. The interface shows application icons for FaceTime, Home, Music, Messages, and Photos. The colors are vibrant and the screen is extremely sharp.

scenes.audio: It can recognize different people in the family.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: The device is now shown in a real-world setting, placed on a wooden kitchen counter. In the background, there is a blurred kitchen environment with warm interior lighting. The device screen is active, showing the device's hardware design in a lifestyle context.

scenes.audio: Use Siri to chat with you and help you control your home appliances.
scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.visual: A close-up view of the screen showing a recipe for French Toast with a high-resolution image of the food. A hand enters from the right side, with the index finger tapping on the screen to interact with the interface. The hand belongs to a person with light skin tone; the rest of the body is out of frame.
